in_hebrew.name: חיגינס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'chag' meaning 'wanderer' or 'traveler', and the suffix 'yn' or 'yns' meaning 'son of'. Thus, 'Higgins' could be interpreted as 'son of the traveler' or 'son of the stranger'.

in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Higginsius' meaning 'son of Higgins' or 'son of the traveler'.
